data.action: 端着托盘小心走过，差点绊倒
data.description: 【深森白夜 · 女仆咖啡打工】装潢精致的女仆咖啡厅里，换上女仆装兼职的白夜小心翼翼地端着装满红茶与蛋糕的托盘穿过走道，步履略显笨拙甚至差点绊倒。稳住身形后她涨红了脸连连鞠躬——「非、非常抱歉！深森白夜为您服务……请主人千万不要投诉我！」
data.promptProse: Byakuya carries a tray of tea and cake through the maid cafe aisle in a simple black dress and white frilled apron. After an awkward near-stumble, she steadies the tray and bows with flushed cheeks. The medium view keeps her hands and balanced dishes together, with table edges guiding the aisle behind. Warm cafe light brightens the porcelain and apron, leaving close shadows beneath the cups on the tray.
data.title: 深森白夜 · 女仆咖啡打工
